CReplay.slot_note: Each ped conversion table entry is a 1988-byte opaque snapshot matching the CPed/CCopPed class layout. Size 1988 = 0x7C4 matches CCopPed. Access via tReplayPedUpdateBlock streaming packets rather than direct field access.

slot_fields.name: _raw_data
slot_fields.note: opaque replay ped snapshot; internal layout mirrors CPed field layout. Use tReplayPedUpdateBlock packets for field-level access.

slot_fields.name: key
slot_fields.note: item key hash used to look up prices in ms_prices[]

slot_fields.name: price
slot_fields.note: base item price in dollars before gPriceMultipliers zone modifier is applied

slot_fields.name: extra_data
slot_fields.note: item-type union: weapon={ammo,0}, clothes={modelKey,textureKey}, tattoos={type1,texKey}, general={extra1,extra2}

slot_fields.name: nameTag
slot_fields.note: display name tag string (null-terminated, max 8 chars); shown in shop UI

structural_facts.fact: CEntryExit record = 0x3C (60 B); DeleteOne divides ptr->index by 60 (reciprocal 0x88888889); pool object at 0x96a7d8
pool layout: array ptr @ pool+0, flag-byte array @ pool+4, count @ pool+8
visible-objects array = 32 slots (cmp 0x20) at 0x96a738, count at 0x96a7dc
replay buffer = 8 blocks x 0x186A0 (100,000 B) at 0x97FB88..0xA43088
same 8 x 100,000 replay buffer walked in FindFirstFocusCoordinate
ped-pool conversion table = 0x8C (140) entries at 0x97F838; ped packet stride 0x7C4
shop items = 0x230 (560); bought-id array @ 0xA97D90, has-bought byte array @ 0xA972A0
ShutdownForRestart clears 0x8C (140) dwords = 560 bytes of the flag array at 0xA972A0
clothes-state buffer = 0x1E (30) dwords (120 B) at 0xA9A810; player-info stride 0x190
shop-section record stride = 0x18 (24 B) (GetExtraInfo; C27.3-verified method)
